wiki_overview.content:
<blog>

# Personal Portfolio Website - Multi-Project Architecture Overview

## Project Introduction

This repository contains a comprehensive personal portfolio website system built as a modern full-stack web application. The project consists of three distinct but interconnected applications: a React-based personal site with admin capabilities, a terminal-style portfolio presentation, and a robust Node.js/Express backend API.

### Purpose Statement
The primary goal is to showcase professional skills, projects, and experiences through an interactive, visually appealing portfolio while providing administrative tools for content management and real-time GitHub integration.

### Core Goals and Objectives
- Deliver a responsive, SEO-optimized personal website with advanced UI/UX features
- Provide comprehensive content management through an integrated admin panel
- Implement real-time GitHub repository integration for project showcase
- Ensure high performance through caching mechanisms and optimized build processes
- Support multiple presentation modes (modern web and retro terminal styles)

### Target Audience
- Potential employers and clients seeking to evaluate technical expertise
- Developers looking for inspiration in modern web development patterns
- Anyone interested in seeing contemporary portfolio implementation techniques

## Technical Architecture

The system follows a monorepo architecture with clear separation of concerns across three main applications:

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[Personal Site Frontend] --> B[Backend API]
    C[Terminal Portfolio] --> B
    D[Admin Panel] --> B
    
    B --> E[MongoDB Database]
    B --> F[GitHub API]
    
    A --> G[React + TypeScript]
    C --> H[Terminal UI Framework]
    D --> I[Admin Components]
    
    B --> J[Express.js Server]
    J --> K[RESTful API Endpoints]
```

### Component Breakdown

**Frontend Applications:**
- **Personal Site**: Modern React application with shadcn/ui components, advanced animations, and admin capabilities
- **Terminal Portfolio**: Retro-styled presentation with CRT effects and terminal-like navigation
- **Admin Panel**: Comprehensive content management interface with CRUD operations

**Backend Services:**
- **Express.js API**: RESTful service handling authentication, content management, and GitHub integration
- **Database Layer**: MongoDB with Mongoose ODM for data persistence
- **Authentication**: JWT-based security with role-based access control

### Design Patterns

The architecture implements several key design patterns:

- **Repository Pattern**: Used extensively in API layer for data access abstraction
- **Provider Pattern**: Context-based state management for authentication and settings
- **Factory Pattern**: Dynamic component rendering and route management
- **Observer Pattern**: Real-time updates through React Query and WebSocket connections

### System Relationships

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Client as Browser Client
    participant Frontend as Personal Site
    participant API as Backend API
    participant DB as MongoDB
    participant GitHub as GitHub API
    
    Client->>Frontend: User Interaction
    Frontend->>API: HTTP Request
    API->>DB: Database Operation
    DB-->>API: Data Response
    API->>GitHub: External API Call
    GitHub-->>API: Repository Data
    API-->>Frontend: Combined Response
    Frontend-->>Client: Rendered Content
```

## Key Implementation

### Main Entry Points

**Frontend Entry Point:**
- `personalSite/src/main.tsx` - Application bootstrap with routing and provider setup
- `portfolio/src/main.tsx` - Terminal-style portfolio entry point
- `server/src/index.ts` - Express server initialization with middleware configuration

**Configuration Approach:**
- `personalSite/vite.config.ts` - Vite build configuration with proxy setup for API communication
- `server/src/config/database.ts` - MongoDB connection management with automatic reconnection
- `personalSite/tailwind.config.ts` - Custom styling with theme variables and animations

### Core Modules

**Authentication System:**
- `personalSite/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx` - JWT-based authentication with token validation
- `server/src/controllers/authController.ts` - User registration, login, and profile management

**Content Management:**
- `personalSite/src/api/` - API client modules for different content types
- `server/src/controllers/` - CRUD operations for articles, projects, and settings
- `server/src/models/` - Mongoose schemas for data modeling

**GitHub Integration:**
- `personalSite/src/api/githubApi.ts` - GitHub API wrapper with caching
- `server/src/controllers/githubController.ts` - Server-side GitHub data fetching

### External Dependencies

**Frontend Dependencies:**
- React 18.3.1 with React Router DOM for navigation
- Radix UI primitives for accessible component foundation
- Framer Motion for smooth animations and transitions
- Three.js with React Three Fiber for 3D visualizations
- React Query for server state management

**Backend Dependencies:**
- Express.js 4.18.2 for web server framework
- Mongoose 8.0.3 for MongoDB object modeling
- Bcrypt.js 2.4.3 for password hashing
- JWT for secure authentication tokens

### Integration Points

**API Communication:**
- Centralized API configuration in `personalSite/src/lib/apiConfig.ts`
- Proxy configuration in Vite for seamless development experience
- Environment-based URL resolution for different deployment targets

**Caching Strategy:**
- In-memory caching with TTL in `personalSite/src/lib/cache.ts`
- GitHub API response caching to reduce external API calls
- React Query integration for efficient data synchronization

### Component Relationship Diagrams

```mermaid
graph LR
    A[App Component] --> B[AuthProvider]
    A --> C[SettingsProvider]
    A --> D[QueryClientProvider]
    
    B --> E[AuthContext]
    C --> F[SettingsContext]
    D --> G[React Query]
    
    E --> H[ProtectedRoute]
    F --> I[Theme Provider]
    G --> J[API Hooks]
    
    H --> K[Admin Layout]
    I --> L[UI Components]
    J --> M[API Endpoints]
```

## Key Features

### Functionality Overview

**Multi-Application Architecture:**
- Seamless switching between modern and retro presentation styles
- Integrated admin panel for content management
- Real-time GitHub repository integration
- Responsive design supporting all device sizes

**Advanced UI/UX Features:**
- Smooth route transitions with custom animations
- Dynamic page backgrounds with parallax effects
- Interactive 3D elements using Three.js
- Comprehensive dark/light theme support

**Performance Optimizations:**
- Code splitting with React.lazy for faster initial load
- Intelligent caching strategies for API responses
- Optimized build process with Vite
- Progressive web app capabilities

### Implementation Highlights

**Routing Architecture:**
- `personalSite/src/App.tsx` - Complex routing with transition animations
- Custom route ranking system for smooth navigation
- Protected routes with role-based access control

**State Management:**
- Context-based authentication state
- Global settings management
- Local state for UI interactions

**Data Flow:**
- `personalSite/src/lib/cache.ts` - Advanced caching with TTL
- `personalSite/src/lib/apiConfig.ts` - Environment-aware API configuration
- `server/src/config/database.ts` - Robust database connection handling

### Feature Architecture Diagrams

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Loading
    Loading --> Authenticated: Login Success
    Loading --> Unauthenticated: Login Failed
    Authenticated --> AdminPanel: Admin User
    Authenticated --> PublicSite: Regular User
    AdminPanel --> ContentManagement: Manage Articles
    AdminPanel --> ProjectManagement: Manage Projects
    PublicSite --> ArticleView: View Articles
    PublicSite --> ProjectView: View Projects
    ContentManagement --> AdminPanel: Save Changes
    ProjectManagement --> AdminPanel: Save Changes
    ArticleView --> PublicSite: Back to Home
    ProjectView --> PublicSite: Back to Home
    Unauthenticated --> Loading: Try Again
```

**Sources:**
- [package.json](personalSite/package.json)
- [main.tsx](personalSite/src/main.tsx)
- [App.tsx](personalSite/src/App.tsx)
- [index.ts](server/src/index.ts)
- [vite.config.ts](personalSite/vite.config.ts)
- [database.ts](server/src/config/database.ts)
- [apiConfig.ts](personalSite/src/lib/apiConfig.ts)
- [AuthContext.tsx](personalSite/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx)
- [App.tsx](portfolio/src/App.tsx)
- [tailwind.config.ts](personalSite/tailwind.config.ts)
- [User.ts](server/src/models/User.ts)
- [githubApi.ts](personalSite/src/api/githubApi.ts)
- [cache.ts](personalSite/src/lib/cache.ts)

</blog>
